messages.subject: Calderwell CV-7 - R/2025/118 - revised action plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitlow,

Thank you for your letter of 23 October. We attach the revised recall action plan addressing each of your points: completion target raised to 90% with escalation for non-responders, Phase 1 guidance within 10 days, OTA prioritised to connected vehicles, and the VIN schedule with 3/6/12-month reporting confirmed. The company intends to launch on 4 November.

Yours sincerely,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP
